items.exampleEn: There is no milk in the cup.
There are many books in the library.
I will come back at six.

items.audioEn: Ken has only one sister. She is very young.
items.audioZh: Ken 只有一個妹妹，她年紀很小。

items.stemEn: There are ____ students in the classroom.
Do you have ____ brothers or sisters?

items.passageEn: Ken lives in a very small town. There are not many shops here. There is only one school and no cinema. Ken likes his town because the people are very nice. After school, he goes back home and helps his mother.
items.passageZh: Ken 住在一個非常小的城鎮，這裡的商店不多，只有一間學校，也沒有電影院。Ken 喜歡他的城鎮，因為這裡的人都很好。放學後，他會回家幫媽媽的忙。

questions.questionZh: Ken 的城鎮有幾間學校？
Ken 為什麼喜歡他的城鎮？

rubricZh: 用 those 指遠處的多樣東西
名詞用複數 cakes，動詞配合複數（例如 are；寫 taste very good 也正確）
用 very 加強形容詞

items.instructionZh: 用 only 造一個句子，說說某樣東西你只有一個（或只有一點點）。
referenceEn: There is only one cat in my house.
rubricZh: only 可放在數量前（only one pen）或動詞前（I only have…）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 規定 be 動詞用 are，會排除「非常好吃」最貼切的寫法 Those cakes taste very good.（參考答案也未收此寫法）
